description: `createPortal(children, domNode)` renders children into another DOM node while keeping them in the same position in the React tree.
Portals follow the DOM for layout and CSS, but the React tree for context, state and event bubbling.
CSS layering scope created by `z-index`, `transform`, `opacity`... Content inside cannot appear above content outside it, which is why overlays use portals.
Tells assistive technology that content outside the dialog is inert while it is open.
